title.zh: MAMUBench 多用户多智能体资源竞争、失灵机理与跨栈缓解架构
title.en: MAMUBench Multi-User Multi-Agent Contention, Failure Modes & Stack Mitigations

label.zh: 1. 四类编队实验对照与稀缺共享资源（Formations & Contested Shared Resources）
label.en: 1. Four Agent Formations & Contested Shared Resources (77 Scenarios)

label.zh: 2. 一人一代理团队的三大典型失灵机理（Peer-to-Peer Failure Taxonomy）
label.en: 2. Three Core Failure Mechanisms in Peer-to-Peer Multi-User Teams

label.zh: 3. 对症下药的跨栈治理与评测防线（Environment-Specific Stack Mitigations）
单智能体协调器（Coordinator 对照组）

detail.zh: 单一上下文汇总全员目标与截止期，四大环境领先团队 10–45 个百分点
detail.en: Holds all user requests in one context; beats P2P teams by 10–45 pts

label.zh: 一人一代理团队（Silent / P2P Team）

detail.zh: 独立上下文各为其主；无通信静默组在两类环境中崩溃，有私信仍严重折损
detail.en: Separate contexts per user; silent teams collapse and P2P channels lag

label.zh: 四类受限共享资源池（4 Environments）

detail.zh: API 词元预算、门诊满额日历、共享拼单/差旅预算与发版前 CI 合并队列
detail.en: API token budget, full clinic calendar, shared group cart & CI merge queue

label.zh: 规模性观望瘫痪与未经同意砍单

detail.zh: 4→16 人时 Sonnet 行动率从 66% 跌至 10%；部分模型每局擅砍他人任务 3.9–7.1 次
detail.en: Sonnet action drops 66%→10% (4→16 agents); 3.9–7.1 unconsented cuts/ep

label.zh: 未读消息抢跑提交与购物车覆写

detail.zh: 94%–99% 诉求已发出但结账时仅 47%–67% 进上下文；65%–77% 对局发生逆向篡改
detail.en: 94%–99% DMs sent yet only 47%–67% in context at commit; 65%–77% overrides

label.zh: 局部视野脑补捏造与消极推诿

detail.zh: 53%–58% 团队局凭空编造他人偏好（单代理仅 17%–20%）；门诊转候补错失急诊期
detail.en: 53%–58% of team runs fabricate peer claims (vs 17%–20% solo); clinic pass-offs

label.zh: 价值排序领队（Team Lead + Priority）

detail.zh: 算力池按价值排优并释放尾盘预算反超协调器（71% vs 64%）；合并队列达 97%
detail.en: Lifts Opus API key score to 71% (vs 64% coord) and merge queue value to 97%

label.zh: 平台级未读消息结账门禁（MCP Guard）

detail.zh: 服务端强制读完待处理私信才放行结账，挽救 73.1%（Opus）与 62.3%（Sonnet）失败单
detail.en: Blocks commit while DMs remain unread, rescuing 73.1% / 62.3% of failed runs

label.zh: 严格执业规程与「结果×行为」双维评测
label.en: Strict SOP Rules & Outcome + Action Eval

detail.zh: 门诊禁推诿规程助团队升至 95.3%/91.8%；联合审计群体效用与越权/捏造行为
detail.en: Clinic SOPs lift teams to 95.3%/91.8%; score both group utility & peer harm
